I am here in Afar with my sorghum on this small plot. The rains are not reliable here, so I do not want to spend money on chemical fertilizer that may be wasted if the season is dry. I have some animals and I will spread their manure on the field as my father did. I will plant my own seed that I saved from last harvest, and my family will do the work ourselves. Maybe at harvest I will ask one or two neighbors to help for a few days.
